MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk microSD pack fits my repeated use of removable memory cards, and my reader and storage cases make spare cards useful for compatible devices.",
    "The basic Fire TV Stick could add streaming to my older Samsung TV alongside my DVD player, provided it is compatible. That extends the usefulness of equipment I already own."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 4K streaming devices offer features my listed 720p TV cannot fully use, and I would only choose one streaming device right now.",
    "The Echo Dot and smart plug introduce voice control and automation without a need I currently have; buying power strips does not mean I want home automation.",
    "A desktop hard drive does not serve the same purpose as my removable memory cards, and navigation mounts and cables do not imply that I need vehicle tracking.",
    "The mouse and 24-port switch assume computer replacement or networking projects that my recent purchases do not show."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, although I mainly bought accessories to support that tablet.",
    "Shared words such as storage, GPS, and power seem to carry too much weight when the products solve quite different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose practical accessories for existing equipment, so compatibility and the specific job an item performs matter more to me than a broad electronics connection.",
    "My recurring memory-card purchases are a stronger sign of an ongoing need than my occasional purchases of a TV or tablet.",
    "The capabilities of my existing equipment matter: a useful addition to my 720p TV appeals more than extra display features I cannot currently use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and entertainment needs but too often stretched practical accessory purchases into interest in unrelated devices and upgrades."
}
